race.comment: Bit of a lottery to close proceedings. EAGLE EXPRESS (15) makes each-way appeal back in Benchmark company. Finished a close fourth two back in the Listed Alinghi over 1100m at Caulfield then failed at the same trip last time when she was probably looking for more ground. Has a strong 1300m record, draws the fence, and gets in very well after Grima's claim. HILLIER (12) led for home but was no match for SHE'S AN ARTIST when fresh from a spell at the Farm recently. Might have to do a bit of work from a tricky draw but he should be competitive again. KERGUELEN (1) disappointed as $2.40 favourite over 1100m at Randwick last start. Better placed out to this trip and the blinkers going on could be crucial. THEBLADE (10) is back in his right grade today and can make amends.
